description_zh: 调用SearchEvents接口查询报警事件记录
kebab_example: aliyun arms search-events --alert-id 123 --pid atc889zkcf@d8deedfa9bf0000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-type TRACE --alert-type 4 --is-trigger 1 --start-time 1595565300000 --end-time 1595568970000 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchEvents

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule. You can call the SearchAlertRules operation and view the `Id` parameter in the response. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175825.html
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则ID，可调用SearchAlertRules接口获取（对应返回参数中的`Id`），更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175825.html
parameters.name: alert_id

parameters.help_en: The process identifier (PID) of the application that is associated with the alert rule
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: `1`
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果分页的页码。默认为`1`
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: `10`
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果分页的每页项目数量。默认为`10`
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the application that is associated with the alert rule. Valid values:

`TRACE`: application monitoring
`RETCODE`: frontend monitoring
parameters.help_zh:
报警规则关联应用的类型：

`TRACE`：应用监控。
`RETCODE`：前端监控
parameters.name: app_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the alert rule. Valid values:

`1`: custom alert rules to monitor drill-down data sets
`3`: custom alert rules to monitor tiled data sets
`4`: alert rules to monitor the frontend, including the default frontend alert rules
`5`: alert rules to monitor applications, including the default application alert rules
`6`: the default frontend alert rules
`7`: the default application alert rules
`8`: Tracing Analysis alert rules
`101`: Prometheus alert rules
parameters.help_zh:
报警规则类型：

`1`：基于下钻数据集的自定义监控报警规则。
`3`：基于平铺数据集的自定义监控报警规则。
`4`：前端监控报警规则，包含默认前端监控报警规则（AlertType=6）。
`5`：应用监控报警规则，包含默认应用监控报警规则（AlertType=7）。
`6`：默认前端监控报警规则。
`7`：默认应用监控报警规则。
`8`：链路追踪Tracing Analysis报警规则。
`101`：Prometheus监控报警规则
parameters.name: alert_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the alert event is triggered. If you do not set this parameter, all alert events are queried. Valid values:

`1`: The event is triggered.
`0`: The event is not triggered
parameters.help_zh:
报警事件是否被触发，若不填写则查询全部。

`1`：触发
`0`：未触发
parameters.name: is_trigger

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp of the LONG data type, in milliseconds. The default value is 10 minutes before the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询报警事件的开始时间的时间戳。格式为Unix Timestamp Long，单位为毫秒。默认为当前时间的前10分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp of the LONG data type, in milliseconds. The default value is the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询报警事件的结束时间的时间戳。格式为Unix Timestamp Long，单位为毫秒。默认为当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

IsTrigger.description_en:
Specifies whether the alert event is triggered. If you do not set this parameter, all alert events are queried. Valid values:

`1`: The event is triggered.
`0`: The event is not triggered
IsTrigger.description_zh:
报警事件是否被触发，若不填写则查询全部。

`1`：触发
`0`：未触发

Event.description_en: The information about the alert events

AlertId.description_en: The ID of the alert rule that is associated with the event

AlertName.description_en: The name of the alert rule that is associated with the event
AlertName.description_zh: 事件关联的报警规则名称

AlertRule.description_en: The condition of the alert rule
AlertRule.description_zh: 事件关联的报警规则判断条件配置

AlertType.description_en:
The type of the alert rule. This parameter is not returned. Valid values:

`1`: custom alert rules to monitor drill-down data sets
`3`: custom alert rules to monitor tiled data sets
`4`: alert rules to monitor the frontend, including the default frontend alert rules
`5`: alert rules to monitor applications, including the default application alert rules
`6`: the default frontend alert rules
`7`: the default application alert rules
`8`: Tracing Analysis alert rules
`101`: Prometheus alert rules
AlertType.description_zh:
事件关联的报警规则类型（一般不展示）：

`1`：基于下钻数据集的自定义监控报警规则。
`3`：基于平铺数据集的自定义监控报警规则。
`4`：前端监控报警规则，包含默认前端监控报警规则（AlertType=6）。
`5`：应用监控报警规则，包含默认应用监控报警规则（AlertType=7）。
`6`：默认前端监控报警规则。
`7`：默认应用监控报警规则。
`8`：链路追踪Tracing Analysis报警规则。
`101`：Prometheus监控报警规则

EventTime.description_en: The timestamp when the event occurred
EventTime.description_zh: 事件发生时间的时间戳

Id.description_en: The ID of the event record

items.description_en: The region ID of the instance with which the connection is associated
items.description_zh: 事件还原现场链接列表

Message.description_en: The event content. The parameter value is a JSON string. Each key indicates a dimension and each value indicates the alert content in the dimension
Message.description_zh: 事件内容，为JSONString格式，键表示维度，值表示此维度的报警内容
Message.example:
unknow紧急报警
ip：172.27.XX.XX
应用名 = test
Region = cn-shenzhen
异常信息 = {"timestamp"："1615447972235"}

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 查询结果分页的每页项目数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
